description: {a(1), a(2), ..., a(n)} is a prime subset containing minimum number of primes such that all even numbers from 4 to 2e = a(n) + 2k - 1 can be written in the form of a(i) + a(j) at least once, and 2e + 2 = a(n) + a(m) is the smallest even number that cannot be written in the form a(i) + a(j), where 1 <= i, j, m < n.
